summary: The open AI model ecosystem in 2026 centers on Hugging Face as the dominant hub, hosting over two million models though the ecosystem is highly concentrated (the top 200 models account for ~49.6% of all downloads, while about half of models have fewer than 200 downloads). Around this hub, a layer of developer-facing inference platforms (Together AI, Fireworks AI, Replicate, SiliconFlow, DeepInfra, OpenRouter) compete on cost, latency, and OpenAI-compatible APIs, while local-serving tools like Ollama, LM Studio, and vLLM bring open models to desktops and self-hosted GPUs. Notably, open model momentum shifted in early 2026 as DeepSeek overtook Mistral in cumulative Hugging Face downloads (128.2M vs 124.3M) and Llama crossed 476M cumulative downloads.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open repository and community hub for AI models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), plus hosted inference via its Inference Providers tier that routes to third-party serving backends.
platforms.pricing: Free public hosting for models/datasets; Pro at ~$9/month; Spaces and dedicated Inference Endpoints billed by compute (GPU/hour); Inference Providers billed per-token/usage, often passed through from partner providers.
features: Largest model and dataset registry with Git-based versioning
Inference Endpoints and Inference Providers routing
Model cards, safetensors, and rich community collaboration
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers who want the broadest selection of open models and the strongest community/tooling ecosystem.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local-first runtime for downloading and running open LLMs on a developer's own machine with a simple CLI and REST API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated/quantized models in its library (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Gemma, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source; runs on your own hardware with no usage fees.
features: GGUF-based quantized models for consumer hardware
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally for prototyping, offline use, or self-hosted apps.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Serverless API platform for running open-source models (LLMs, image, audio, video) via a simple pay-per-second pattern, with easy packaging and sharing of custom models.
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second of compute based on hardware tier; no idle/subscription fees for most usage.
features: Cog for packaging models into reproducible containers
Strong support for image/video/audio generation models
platforms.best_for: App developers and indie builders who want to call diverse open models (especially multimodal/generative) via a clean API without managing GPUs.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: Developer inference and fine-tuning cloud focused on low-cost, high-throughput serving of open LLMs via an OpenAI-compatible API.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, and more)
platforms.pricing: Per-token pricing for inference (among the lowest-cost options); dedicated endpoints and fine-tuning billed by compute/usage.
features: Optimized inference stack for open models
platforms.best_for: Teams building production LLM apps on open models who prioritize low cost and drop-in OpenAI API compatibility.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: Performance-focused inference platform offering fast, low-latency serving of open LLMs and multimodal models with an OpenAI-compatible API.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models plus custom/fine-tuned model hosting
platforms.pricing: Per-token pricing for serverless inference; dedicated deployments and fine-tuning billed by GPU usage.
platforms.best_for: Developers who need fast, production-grade inference for open models with strong latency and throughput guarantees.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: All-in-one, best-value platform for both hosting and high-performance inference of open models, emphasizing fast inference and cost efficiency.
platforms.model_count: Broad catalog of popular open LLMs and multimodal models
platforms.pricing: Competitive per-token/usage-based pricing positioned as a best-value option for 2026.
features: Combined hosting and inference in one platform
Support for text and multimodal models
platforms.best_for: Organizations seeking the best price/performance balance for deploying open models without stitching together multiple vendors.

platforms.name: DeepInfra
platforms.purpose: Serverless inference provider offering low-cost per-token access to a wide range of open LLMs and multimodal models via a simple API.
platforms.pricing: Per-token pay-as-you-go pricing, positioned as a low-cost inference option.
platforms.best_for: Cost-sensitive developers wanting direct, no-frills per-token access to open models.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: Unified API gateway that routes requests across many model providers (open and proprietary) through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models aggregated across dozens of providers
platforms.pricing: Pass-through per-token pricing from underlying providers plus a small routing margin; pay-as-you-go with unified billing.
features: Single API and key for many providers
Automatic routing, fallback, and price/latency selection
Access to both open and closed models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want provider flexibility and easy comparison/failover across many models without integrating each vendor separately.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.purpose: Python-first serverless GPU compute platform for deploying custom model inference, fine-tuning, and batch workloads with full control over the environment.
platforms.model_count: Any model (bring-your-own); not a fixed catalog
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second GPU/CPU compute; scale-to-zero with no idle cost.
features: Custom containers and full environment control
Good for both inference and training/batch jobs
platforms.best_for: ML engineers who want programmable, full-control serverless GPU infrastructure for custom open-model workloads.

platforms.name: Baseten
platforms.purpose: Production-oriented platform for deploying and serving ML/LLM models with scalable, low-latency endpoints.
platforms.model_count: Bring-your-own models plus prebuilt open model templates (Truss)
platforms.pricing: Usage-based GPU/compute pricing for dedicated and autoscaling deployments.
platforms.best_for: Teams moving open or custom models into reliable, scalable production inference.

platforms.name: RunPod
platforms.purpose: Low-cost GPU cloud for raw GPU rental and serverless inference, popular for self-hosted open model serving.
platforms.pricing: Per-hour GPU rental (community and secure cloud tiers) and per-second serverless endpoints.
features: Affordable on-demand and spot GPU instances
Good for self-hosting vLLM and custom stacks
platforms.best_for: Cost-conscious developers who want raw GPU access to self-host open models and inference servers.

platforms.name: vLLM
platforms.purpose: Open-source high-throughput inference and serving engine for self-hosting open LLMs on your own GPUs.
platforms.model_count: Supports most mainstream open LLM architectures (not a catalog)
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source; cost is only the underlying hardware/cloud GPU.
platforms.best_for: Infrastructure teams self-hosting open models who need maximum throughput and control over their serving stack.

platforms.name: LM Studio
platforms.purpose: Desktop application for discovering, downloading, and running open LLMs locally with a GUI and local API server.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of GGUF models accessible via Hugging Face integration
platforms.pricing: Free for personal use; runs entirely on local hardware.
features: Direct GGUF model search and download
platforms.best_for: Individual developers and non-technical users who want an easy local GUI for running open models privately.
